## Why Choose Us

[[Wrist Watches, Automatic Watch, Women Watches - Aiers]][16]

Why Choose Us: Aiers - The Ultimate High-End Watch Manufacturer

When it comes to watches, there are countless options available in the market. From luxury brands to
affordable alternatives, the choices seem endless. Amidst this sea of options, one name stands out -
Aiers. Established more than 17 years ago, Aiers is a high-end watch manufacturer that supplies to
many international and e-commerce micro watch brands in over 20 markets. With our specialization in
high-quality watches, diverse range of designs and specifications, and reliable customer service, it
is no wonder why more and more people are choosing Aiers as their go-to watch brand.

One of the key factors that set Aiers apart from other watch manufacturers is our commitment to
producing high-quality watches. We believe that a timepiece is not just a functional accessory but
also a reflection of one's personality and style. This is why we pay meticulous attention to detail
during the manufacturing process to ensure that each watch we produce meets the highest standards of
quality. From selecting the finest materials to employing skilled craftsmen, we leave no stone
unturned in creating watches that exude elegance and sophistication.

At Aiers, we understand that every individual has their own unique preferences and tastes when it
comes to watches. This is why we offer an extensive range of designs and specifications to cater to
diverse needs. Whether you are looking for a classic timepiece with a leather strap or a modern
watch with a stainless steel bracelet, you will find an array of options to choose from in our
collection. Moreover, our watches come in various sizes, colors, and functionalities, ensuring that
there is something for everyone.

Another reason why choosing Aiers is a wise decision is the use of different materials in our
watches. We constantly push the boundaries of innovation by interweaving traditional craftsmanship
with modern technology. This results in timepieces that not only look exquisite but also boast
durability and longevity. By utilizing materials such as high-grade stainless steel, sapphire
crystals, and genuine leather, we create watches that can withstand the test of time and are
resistant to everyday wear and tear.

Besides the exceptional quality and design of our watches, Aiers also takes pride in providing
excellent customer service. We understand that buying a watch is not a mere transaction but an
experience, and we aim to make this experience as seamless and delightful as possible. Our
knowledgeable and friendly customer support team is always ready to assist you with any queries or
concerns you may have. Additionally, we offer hassle-free warranty and repair services to ensure
that your watch remains in top-notch condition for years to come.

Choosing Aiers as your watch brand of choice also means supporting a company with a strong social
and environmental commitment. We take our responsibility towards sustainability seriously by
implementing practices that minimize our carbon footprint and promote ethical sourcing of materials.
We believe that it is not just about creating exceptional watches but also about making a positive
impact on the world around us.

In conclusion, when it comes to high-end watches, Aiers is a brand that stands tall in the industry.
With over 17 years of experience, we have established ourselves as a trusted and reliable watch
manufacturer. Our commitment to producing high-quality watches, extensive range of designs and
specifications, exceptional customer service, and dedication to sustainability make us the ultimate
choice for watch enthusiasts worldwide. So, why choose us? Because at Aiers, we are passionate about
creating timepieces that are not just watches but timeless works of art.

## Our Story

Approximately 18 million people worldwide die of heart disease every year, making cardiovascular
diseases the number-one killer worldwide. Nearly 50% of all adults have at least one risk factor for
heart disease, yet because of the lack of symptoms and accessible heart monitoring technology, most
cases go undetected until it’s too late.

Patch Inc. established in 2018 in the USA, is an innovative digital healthcare company that aims to
make cardiac care affordable and accessible anywhere, anytime. We combine human intelligence and
artificial intelligence into ultra-light, everyday-wearable patch which provides continuous cardiac
monitoring and timely detections and alerts.

***The best way to battle heart disease is*** *prevention.*
***The best strategy to prevent is*** *early detection*.

## patchQuick

### *Taking an ECG has never been easier. Attach. Position. Record*

A single test that provides early detection of cardiac abnormalities may add years to a patient’s
life. Although many patients seeing a physician have risk factors that indicate screening for
arrhythmias should be done, having the technology, staffing, and time in the physician office can be
a challenge. ***patch**Quick* is designed to address these issues, keeping the doctor’s workflow in
mind.

While waiting to see the physician, ***patch**Quick* screening can be done in the waiting room. It
is a rapid, seamless test that does not add any burden to the office staff. Once the patient is
ready to see the physician, the ECG, with the analysis, is ready for the physician to review as part
of the office visit.

The device is lighter than a pen and can test the heart in less than 30 seconds. Just as reliable as
the standard echocardiography machines, but without the hassle. Patient data is always safe and we
strictly follow HIPAA compliance.

### What’s the need for Cardiac Screening?

### Screening is needed for people who have:
* Heart disease is the #1 killer and stroke is the #3 killer
* Approximately 18 million people worldwide die of heart disease every year
* Around 50% of adults have at least 1 key risk factor.
* Heart disease strikes people at an early age often without warning
* Many arrhythmias occur without symptoms
* * High Blood pressure
  * High Cholesterol
  * Family History
  * Excessive alcohol use
  * Diabetes
  * Smoking
  * Age>60
  * Obesity
  * No Physician Prescription needed

## patchPro

### Long-term cardiac monitoring for diagnosis and therapy management
* Ultralight weight
* Effortless Onboarding
* Rechargeable / 7 days of battery life
* Off-shelf electrodes
* Waterproof
* No data lost even when no signal
* Artificial Intelligence
* Edge Computing
* Real-time detection
* Activity-based tagging
* 24*7*365 Quality Assurance
* Full disclosure option

Patient data is always safe and we strictly follow HIPAA compliance.
Patient types include:
* Those with intermittent symptoms suggestive of an arrhythmia such as palpitations, syncope,
  lightheadedness
* those with known arrhythmias, such as atrial fibrillation, that may need more intensive monitoring
  to guide therapy
* those with cryptogenic stroke to monitor for atrial fibrillation
* those diagnosed with an arrhythmia during patchQuick screening

###### Continue living life to the fullest

Smaller than an iPhone, 7-day battery life, and continuous recording means you can go on living life
as normal.

###### Splash resistant

Life and Weather proof, so you can take it with you everywhere

###### Continuously records heart activity

Constantly records your heart activity, which can be analyzed by expert cardiologists at a moment's
notice.

## Testimonials

helpful for people to recognise risks and early detection.”

conducting a free campaign for our employees, where they felt it was very helpful to understand
their ECGs.”

Color Threads, Tiruppur, India.

# **Company Headquarters**

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing
accurate, up-to-date headquarters information for tens of thousands of leading companies across the
United States and around the world. Our platform is designed to serve as a trusted resource for
users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

We provide this headquarters information completely free of charge, making it easy to access
essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

Behind the scenes, our dedicated team works around the clock to collect, organize, and validate
headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This
process ensures that outdated, incomplete, or misleading information is minimized, and that users
can rely on our directory with confidence.

Company Headquarters is committed to maintaining one of the most reliable and user-friendly
headquarters information directories available online. By continuously monitoring data updates and
verifying corporate details, we make sure the best and most accurate headquarters information is
accessible to users at all times, helping them quickly find the corporate contact and location
details they need, all in one convenient place.

Browse through our carefully selected headquarters listings to quickly locate the company
headquarters you are searching for, whether the organization operates locally, nationally, or
internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users
to explore companies by name, category, or relevance and efficiently access accurate corporate
headquarters information in just a few clicks.

For a faster and more direct experience, you can also use the headquarters search box to search
across our complete headquarters directory. This powerful search feature enables you to instantly
find detailed company headquarters information, including corporate phone numbers, official
addresses, office locations, websites, and additional verified data, all from one centralized
platform.

## 南京金陵饭店

南京金陵饭店(Jinling Hotel
Nanjing)旺中带静，交通便利，是南京受欢迎的豪华酒店之一，全体酒店员工期待您的光临，在线预订更享优惠价
格。

**南京金陵饭店**位于鼓楼区汉中路，近中山路；饭店四周德基广场、金鹰购物中心、哈姆雷斯等大型购物中心近
在咫尺，饭店还无缝连接地铁1、2号线及便捷的公共交通，得天独厚的地理位置使您的出行更加轻松与高效。**南
京金陵饭店**是南京城市的“中心地标”，东西方文化在这里交相辉映。1983年开业至今，**南京金陵饭店**多次成
功地接待世界多国政要及名流巨商。饭店拥有979间客房，超过4000平方米会议场地，6家荟萃中西美食的餐厅，35
00平方米健身俱乐部，悦椿SPA及11000平方米精品地下商业街区“金陵风尚”。无论是商务旅行或是家庭出游，深具
东方情韵的金陵饭店皆能用心满足每位客人的个性化需求。

入住南京金陵饭店您将享受酒店的尊贵服务，轻松到达南京的各主要商业中心和景点，欢迎您预订我们酒店！

Nanjing)旺中带静，交通便利，是南京受欢迎的豪华酒店之一，全体酒店员工期待您的光临，在线预订更享优惠价
格。

**南京金陵饭店**位于鼓楼区汉中路，近中山路；饭店四周德基广场、金鹰购物中心、哈姆雷斯等大型购物中心近
在咫尺，饭店还无缝连接地铁1、2号线及便捷的公共交通，得天独厚的地理位置使您的出行更加轻松与高效。**南
京金陵饭店**是南京城市的“中心地标”，东西方文化在这里交相辉映。1983年开业至今，**南京金陵饭店**多次成
功地接待世界多国政要及名流巨商。饭店拥有979间客房，超过4000平方米会议场地，6家荟萃中西美食的餐厅，35
00平方米健身俱乐部，悦椿SPA及11000平方米精品地下商业街区“金陵风尚”。无论是商务旅行或是家庭出游，深具
东方情韵的金陵饭店皆能用心满足每位客人的个性化需求。

## Hydration is the missing vital sign.

It shapes cognition, reaction time and physical output every day - yet we routinely underestimate
its impact. By the time thirst kicks in, you're already behind, and there's still no continuous way
to measure it. The signal that matters most stays invisible until the damage is done.

Yet there is no conclusive way to measure it

## Decoding dehydration.

Fluid balance moves *before* performance does. Track it continuously and you can see strain build
before it's felt - across sleep, cognitive load and physical output.

Omni's models are built and measured against clinical gold standards, prioritising both lab and real
world evidence.

Fluid leaves the system

Sweat and exertion can remove fluid faster than you replace it. As the deficit grows, plasma volume
begins to fall.

02
Circulation responds

To compensate, your heart rate and vascular tone adjust, changing how blood moves through your
circulation.

03
The signal shifts

These circulatory changes alter the optical (PPG) signal that wearables already capture, from Garmin
smartwatches to clinical finger pulse oximeters.

04
A personalised hydration index

Compared against your own baseline, our algorithms turn these shifts into a live hydration score, a
simple fluid target, and your trend over time.

* What is PointFit?+
  PointFit's non-invasive skin patch tracks personal health by continuously analyzing sweat
  biomarkers—such as lactate, glucose, electrolytes, and cortisol—in real time. Unlike traditional
  blood tests or needle-based monitors, this wearable patch offers a pain-free, discreet, and
  convenient solution for athletes, patients, and health enthusiasts.
* Who is PointFit for?+
  PointFit is for athletes and fitness enthusiasts seeking better performance. Our sweat-based data
  optimizes training and recovery for all levels.
* Why sweat?+
  Sweat stands out for its ability to provide continuous, non-invasive health monitoring without
  needles, unlike blood or urine, which require invasive or intermittent sampling. While saliva can
  also be non-invasive, sweat’s rich biomarkers, like lactate and cortisol, deliver real-time
  insights during exercise, which is uniquely effective for personalized performance data.
* How is PointFit different from other wearables in the market?+
  Unlike most wearables in the market that track basic signals like heart rate or oxygen levels
  using light-based sensors, PointFit measures biochemicals in your sweat, such as lactate and
  cortisol. This provides deeper health insights typically available through blood tests or lab
  analysis.

Have questions?

We've got you covered
* What is PointFit?+
  PointFit's non-invasive skin patch tracks personal health by continuously analyzing sweat
  biomarkers—such as lactate, glucose, electrolytes, and cortisol—in real time. Unlike traditional
  blood tests or needle-based monitors, this wearable patch offers a pain-free, discreet, and
  convenient solution for athletes, patients, and health enthusiasts.
* Who is PointFit for?+
  PointFit is for athletes and fitness enthusiasts seeking better performance. Our sweat-based data
  optimizes training and recovery for all levels.
* Why sweat?+
  Sweat stands out for its ability to provide continuous, non-invasive health monitoring without
  needles, unlike blood or urine, which require invasive or intermittent sampling. While saliva can
  also be non-invasive, sweat’s rich biomarkers, like lactate and cortisol, deliver real-time
  insights during exercise, which is uniquely effective for personalized performance data.
* How is PointFit different from other wearables in the market?+
  Unlike most wearables in the market that track basic signals like heart rate or oxygen levels
  using light-based sensors, PointFit measures biochemicals in your sweat, such as lactate and
  cortisol. This provides deeper health insights typically available through blood tests or lab
  analysis.
* What is PointFit's core technology?+
  PointFits patented nanomembrane skin patch uses a unique sweat-sensing method called Evaporative
  Dermal Biosensing to track health markers. This ultra-thin technology captures precise data
  comfortably and non-invasively. It’s designed to give you reliable insights with ease.
* What biomarkers can the PF-Sweat Sensor measure?+
  The PF-Sweat Sensor tracks key biomarkers like lactate, cortisol, and electrolytes in your sweat.
  These markers reveal insights about muscle performance, stress, and hydration. This helps you
  optimize your training and health effortlessly.
* How accurate is it compared to blood?+
  The PF-Sweat Sensor achieves a high accuracy of 92% compared to blood tests for key biomarkers
  like lactate. This non-invasive method delivers reliable results without the discomfort of
  needles. You get lab-quality insights right from your sweat.
* Why do you need to know lactate for your endurance training?+
  Lactate can be used to determine your lactate threshold, the point at which your body produces
  more lactate than can be used for energy in the lactic acid cycle. Knowing this will help you
  train smarter by staying in optimal intensity zones, which will help prevent overtraining,
  injuries, and muscle acidity. Lactate is key for boosting endurance, avoiding overexertion, and
  for optimal training.

## Healthcare monitoring doesn't have to be invasive and painful

Our non-invasive sweat sensor technology provides seamless, real-time health insights with comfort
and ease. Join our beta program to experience the future of effortless wellness tracking.

report and document analysis is generated by models specifically trained on medical imaging and

### Google MedGemma 1.5

CT & MRI Scan Analysis

Your [CT scan][43] & [MRI scan][44] are evaluated by **MedGemma 1.5 from Google Research**. This is
a specialized 4-billion-parameter medical AI built on Gemma 3, with a medically-tuned vision encoder
(MedSigLIP) trained on de-identified medical imaging data. It reviews every slice of your scan as a
complete 3D volume — just like a radiologist would.
* Full 3D volumetric analysis of CT and MRI DICOM series
* Understands MRI sequences: T1, T2, FLAIR, DWI, contrast-enhanced
* Trained on medical imaging datasets including MIMIC-CXR and ChestImaGenome
* 128K token context window for processing large scan series

handles question answering, summarization, and reasoning to synthesize findings from multiple
sources and deliver context-aware explanations in plain language.
* State-of-the-art results on the MedQA benchmark
* Analyzes lab reports, bloodwork, clinical notes, and X-rays
* Connects lab results, scan data, and clinical notes for cross-referenced insights
* Ask unlimited follow-up questions in plain language

### Vpatch is a wearable cardiac arrhythmia 

### detection system.

### The proprietary real-time, wireless ECG monitoring and reporting capabilities ensures superior

## Beats of Interest (™)

## Wireless Interpretive Wearable (™)

##### What is Vpatch?

Vpatch Cardio Pty Ltd (VPC) has developed a cutting edge cardiac arrhythmia detection system with
dramatically improved diagnostic yield and patient compliance.


VPC is well positioned to take advantage of the fast growing mHealth market with a medical
diagnostic device enabling real-time monitoring of a patient’s cardiac status.


The patented advanced technology is designed for both long and short term monitoring primarily as a
cardiac diagnostic tool and extends to cardiac rehabilitation, clinical drug trials, post-operative
surveillance, sports performance medicine and emergency medicine.


Vpatch™ analyses every heartbeat and transmits in real time only episodes of interest as selected by
physicians, making it a valuable tool for safely and discretely monitoring at-risk patients in their
normal environment without confinement to hospital or any limitation of mobility.


###### Compactness

Easy to carry and use for anyone of all ages.

###### Features

Light weight and unobtrusive design. May be worn for up to 7 days or longer

###### Useability

User-friendly and easy to use with a click of a button.

#### Who is Vpatch for?

The VPC system is a mHealth solution for clinicians and physicians to monitor patients remotely and
unobtrusively to aid faster and better diagnosis and treatment.

Cardiovascular disease and stroke are still the number one killers in both modern and developing
nations around the world, and the numbers of patients are increasing as we live longer.  Every year
there are 4.5 million cardiovascular deaths in Europe, over 1 million in the USA, 3.8 million in
India and 1 in 5 Chinese adults have cardiovascular disease.  These numbers are expected to increase
by 40% by the year 2035.


Almost half of heart related calls to the doctor are due to the most common arrhythmia, atrial
fibrillation, (AF).  Often missed by conventional detection methods such as Holter tests, AF can
lead to blood clots and strokes if left untreated.


With a light weight design and long battery life, Vpatch is able to be worn discreetly by a patient
for a week or more, making it far more likely to detect unfelt cardiac events and aiding with swift
diagnosis and immediate treatment.

#### Why use Vpatch?

With better diagnostic yield and significantly longer monitoring periods, Vpatch is the leading
cardiac detection device on the market.

The bourgeoning health trend is in early detection and treatment using mHealth technologies to save
time and money based on prevention for patients and institutions.


As cost effective as it is clever, Vpatch is suitable for hospital, home or remote monitoring and is
self- activating when arrhythmias are detected. There are no leads which reduces motion artefact
error by over 90% and patients can go about their normal business while being monitored. Patients
under investigation are more likely to be diagnosed, not only for an event, but for a pattern of
occurrence to aid with treatment decisions.


Vpatch complies with reimbursement criteria in Australia and other countries using similar
diagnostic related groupings for Government or Private Health Insurance.

## Why Choose Us

[[Wrist Watches, Automatic Watch, Women Watches - Aiers]][16]

Why Choose Us: Aiers - The Ultimate High-End Watch Manufacturer

When it comes to watches, there are countless options available in the market. From luxury brands to
affordable alternatives, the choices seem endless. Amidst this sea of options, one name stands out -
Aiers. Established more than 17 years ago, Aiers is a high-end watch manufacturer that supplies to
many international and e-commerce micro watch brands in over 20 markets. With our specialization in
high-quality watches, diverse range of designs and specifications, and reliable customer service, it
is no wonder why more and more people are choosing Aiers as their go-to watch brand.

One of the key factors that set Aiers apart from other watch manufacturers is our commitment to
producing high-quality watches. We believe that a timepiece is not just a functional accessory but
also a reflection of one's personality and style. This is why we pay meticulous attention to detail
during the manufacturing process to ensure that each watch we produce meets the highest standards of
quality. From selecting the finest materials to employing skilled craftsmen, we leave no stone
unturned in creating watches that exude elegance and sophistication.

At Aiers, we understand that every individual has their own unique preferences and tastes when it
comes to watches. This is why we offer an extensive range of designs and specifications to cater to
diverse needs. Whether you are looking for a classic timepiece with a leather strap or a modern
watch with a stainless steel bracelet, you will find an array of options to choose from in our
collection. Moreover, our watches come in various sizes, colors, and functionalities, ensuring that
there is something for everyone.

Another reason why choosing Aiers is a wise decision is the use of different materials in our
watches. We constantly push the boundaries of innovation by interweaving traditional craftsmanship
with modern technology. This results in timepieces that not only look exquisite but also boast
durability and longevity. By utilizing materials such as high-grade stainless steel, sapphire
crystals, and genuine leather, we create watches that can withstand the test of time and are
resistant to everyday wear and tear.

Besides the exceptional quality and design of our watches, Aiers also takes pride in providing
excellent customer service. We understand that buying a watch is not a mere transaction but an
experience, and we aim to make this experience as seamless and delightful as possible. Our
knowledgeable and friendly customer support team is always ready to assist you with any queries or
concerns you may have. Additionally, we offer hassle-free warranty and repair services to ensure
that your watch remains in top-notch condition for years to come.

Choosing Aiers as your watch brand of choice also means supporting a company with a strong social
and environmental commitment. We take our responsibility towards sustainability seriously by
implementing practices that minimize our carbon footprint and promote ethical sourcing of materials.
We believe that it is not just about creating exceptional watches but also about making a positive
impact on the world around us.

In conclusion, when it comes to high-end watches, Aiers is a brand that stands tall in the industry.
With over 17 years of experience, we have established ourselves as a trusted and reliable watch
manufacturer. Our commitment to producing high-quality watches, extensive range of designs and
specifications, exceptional customer service, and dedication to sustainability make us the ultimate
choice for watch enthusiasts worldwide. So, why choose us? Because at Aiers, we are passionate about
creating timepieces that are not just watches but timeless works of art.

## Our Story

Approximately 18 million people worldwide die of heart disease every year, making cardiovascular
diseases the number-one killer worldwide. Nearly 50% of all adults have at least one risk factor for
heart disease, yet because of the lack of symptoms and accessible heart monitoring technology, most
cases go undetected until it’s too late.

Patch Inc. established in 2018 in the USA, is an innovative digital healthcare company that aims to
make cardiac care affordable and accessible anywhere, anytime. We combine human intelligence and
artificial intelligence into ultra-light, everyday-wearable patch which provides continuous cardiac
monitoring and timely detections and alerts.

***The best way to battle heart disease is*** *prevention.*
***The best strategy to prevent is*** *early detection*.

## patchQuick

### *Taking an ECG has never been easier. Attach. Position. Record*

A single test that provides early detection of cardiac abnormalities may add years to a patient’s
life. Although many patients seeing a physician have risk factors that indicate screening for
arrhythmias should be done, having the technology, staffing, and time in the physician office can be
a challenge. ***patch**Quick* is designed to address these issues, keeping the doctor’s workflow in
mind.

While waiting to see the physician, ***patch**Quick* screening can be done in the waiting room. It
is a rapid, seamless test that does not add any burden to the office staff. Once the patient is
ready to see the physician, the ECG, with the analysis, is ready for the physician to review as part
of the office visit.

The device is lighter than a pen and can test the heart in less than 30 seconds. Just as reliable as
the standard echocardiography machines, but without the hassle. Patient data is always safe and we
strictly follow HIPAA compliance.

* Heart disease is the #1 killer and stroke is the #3 killer
* Approximately 18 million people worldwide die of heart disease every year
* Around 50% of adults have at least 1 key risk factor.
* Heart disease strikes people at an early age often without warning
* Many arrhythmias occur without symptoms
* * High Blood pressure
  * High Cholesterol

  * Diabetes
  * Smoking
  * Age>60
  * Obesity
  * No Physician Prescription needed

## 南京金陵饭店

南京金陵饭店(Jinling Hotel
Nanjing)旺中带静，交通便利，是南京受欢迎的豪华酒店之一，全体酒店员工期待您的光临，在线预订更享优惠价
格。

**南京金陵饭店**位于鼓楼区汉中路，近中山路；饭店四周德基广场、金鹰购物中心、哈姆雷斯等大型购物中心近
在咫尺，饭店还无缝连接地铁1、2号线及便捷的公共交通，得天独厚的地理位置使您的出行更加轻松与高效。**南
京金陵饭店**是南京城市的“中心地标”，东西方文化在这里交相辉映。1983年开业至今，**南京金陵饭店**多次成
功地接待世界多国政要及名流巨商。饭店拥有979间客房，超过4000平方米会议场地，6家荟萃中西美食的餐厅，35
00平方米健身俱乐部，悦椿SPA及11000平方米精品地下商业街区“金陵风尚”。无论是商务旅行或是家庭出游，深具
东方情韵的金陵饭店皆能用心满足每位客人的个性化需求。

入住南京金陵饭店您将享受酒店的尊贵服务，轻松到达南京的各主要商业中心和景点，欢迎您预订我们酒店！

## [酒店问答][17]

*Q：南京金陵饭店是几星级的?*

*Q：南京金陵饭店在哪里?*
  A：您好，南京金陵饭店位于汉中路2号, 鼓楼区, 南京, 江苏, 中国。

*Q：南京金陵饭店如何预订?*
  A：可以通过**[南京金陵饭店][18]**网站进行预订，各大旅游平台也是可以预订的。

*Q：预订后，几点可以入住酒店?*
  A：正常情况下是下午2点开始入住，如果早到的话要看有没有房间，如果有房间一般是可以提前入住，并且是免
  费的。

*Q：南京金陵饭店可以开增值税专用发票吗?*
  A：您好，可以开的，在您退房时在前台开具。

## Hydration is the missing vital sign.

It shapes cognition, reaction time and physical output every day - yet we routinely underestimate
its impact. By the time thirst kicks in, you're already behind, and there's still no continuous way
to measure it. The signal that matters most stays invisible until the damage is done.

Yet there is no conclusive way to measure it
CLINICAL STANDARD
Blood and urine analysis
01
Unavailable
Requires a clinic and a venous blood draw - not the field.
02
Inaccessible
Cost and turnaround put it out of reach for daily use.
03
Invasive
A needle and a lab - never continuous, never live.
INDUSTRY STANDARD
Urine tests and saliva swabs
01
Point-in-time
One reading at the gate says nothing about the next ten hours.
02
Lagging and inaccurate
It confirms strain after the fact, and often gets it wrong.
03
Invasive and ignored
Intrusive enough that workers routinely skip it.
THE THESIS

## Decoding dehydration.

Fluid balance moves *before* performance does. Track it continuously and you can see strain build
before it's felt - across sleep, cognitive load and physical output.

Omni's models are built and measured against clinical gold standards, prioritising both lab and real
world evidence.

01
Fluid leaves the system

Sweat and exertion can remove fluid faster than you replace it. As the deficit grows, plasma volume
begins to fall.

02
Circulation responds

To compensate, your heart rate and vascular tone adjust, changing how blood moves through your
circulation.

03
The signal shifts

These circulatory changes alter the optical (PPG) signal that wearables already capture, from Garmin
smartwatches to clinical finger pulse oximeters.

04
A personalised hydration index

Compared against your own baseline, our algorithms turn these shifts into a live hydration score, a
simple fluid target, and your trend over time.

* What is PointFit?+
  PointFit's non-invasive skin patch tracks personal health by continuously analyzing sweat
  biomarkers—such as lactate, glucose, electrolytes, and cortisol—in real time. Unlike traditional
  blood tests or needle-based monitors, this wearable patch offers a pain-free, discreet, and
  convenient solution for athletes, patients, and health enthusiasts.
* Who is PointFit for?+
  PointFit is for athletes and fitness enthusiasts seeking better performance. Our sweat-based data
  optimizes training and recovery for all levels.
* Why sweat?+
  Sweat stands out for its ability to provide continuous, non-invasive health monitoring without
  needles, unlike blood or urine, which require invasive or intermittent sampling. While saliva can
  also be non-invasive, sweat’s rich biomarkers, like lactate and cortisol, deliver real-time
  insights during exercise, which is uniquely effective for personalized performance data.
* How is PointFit different from other wearables in the market?+
  Unlike most wearables in the market that track basic signals like heart rate or oxygen levels
  using light-based sensors, PointFit measures biochemicals in your sweat, such as lactate and
  cortisol. This provides deeper health insights typically available through blood tests or lab
  analysis.

Have questions?

* What is PointFit?+
  PointFit's non-invasive skin patch tracks personal health by continuously analyzing sweat
  biomarkers—such as lactate, glucose, electrolytes, and cortisol—in real time. Unlike traditional
  blood tests or needle-based monitors, this wearable patch offers a pain-free, discreet, and
  convenient solution for athletes, patients, and health enthusiasts.
* Who is PointFit for?+
  PointFit is for athletes and fitness enthusiasts seeking better performance. Our sweat-based data
  optimizes training and recovery for all levels.
* Why sweat?+
  Sweat stands out for its ability to provide continuous, non-invasive health monitoring without
  needles, unlike blood or urine, which require invasive or intermittent sampling. While saliva can
  also be non-invasive, sweat’s rich biomarkers, like lactate and cortisol, deliver real-time
  insights during exercise, which is uniquely effective for personalized performance data.
* How is PointFit different from other wearables in the market?+
  Unlike most wearables in the market that track basic signals like heart rate or oxygen levels
  using light-based sensors, PointFit measures biochemicals in your sweat, such as lactate and
  cortisol. This provides deeper health insights typically available through blood tests or lab
  analysis.
* What is PointFit's core technology?+
  PointFits patented nanomembrane skin patch uses a unique sweat-sensing method called Evaporative
  Dermal Biosensing to track health markers. This ultra-thin technology captures precise data
  comfortably and non-invasively. It’s designed to give you reliable insights with ease.
* What biomarkers can the PF-Sweat Sensor measure?+
  The PF-Sweat Sensor tracks key biomarkers like lactate, cortisol, and electrolytes in your sweat.
  These markers reveal insights about muscle performance, stress, and hydration. This helps you
  optimize your training and health effortlessly.
* How accurate is it compared to blood?+
  The PF-Sweat Sensor achieves a high accuracy of 92% compared to blood tests for key biomarkers
  like lactate. This non-invasive method delivers reliable results without the discomfort of
  needles. You get lab-quality insights right from your sweat.
* Why do you need to know lactate for your endurance training?+
  Lactate can be used to determine your lactate threshold, the point at which your body produces
  more lactate than can be used for energy in the lactic acid cycle. Knowing this will help you
  train smarter by staying in optimal intensity zones, which will help prevent overtraining,
  injuries, and muscle acidity. Lactate is key for boosting endurance, avoiding overexertion, and
  for optimal training.

## Healthcare monitoring doesn't have to be invasive and painful

Our non-invasive sweat sensor technology provides seamless, real-time health insights with comfort
and ease. Join our beta program to experience the future of effortless wellness tracking.

### Vpatch is a wearable cardiac arrhythmia 

### detection system.

### The proprietary real-time, wireless ECG monitoring and reporting capabilities ensures superior

## Beats of Interest (™)

## Wireless Interpretive Wearable (™)

##### What is Vpatch?

Vpatch Cardio Pty Ltd (VPC) has developed a cutting edge cardiac arrhythmia detection system with
dramatically improved diagnostic yield and patient compliance.


VPC is well positioned to take advantage of the fast growing mHealth market with a medical
diagnostic device enabling real-time monitoring of a patient’s cardiac status.


The patented advanced technology is designed for both long and short term monitoring primarily as a
cardiac diagnostic tool and extends to cardiac rehabilitation, clinical drug trials, post-operative
surveillance, sports performance medicine and emergency medicine.


Vpatch™ analyses every heartbeat and transmits in real time only episodes of interest as selected by
physicians, making it a valuable tool for safely and discretely monitoring at-risk patients in their
normal environment without confinement to hospital or any limitation of mobility.


###### Compactness

Easy to carry and use for anyone of all ages.

###### Features

Light weight and unobtrusive design. May be worn for up to 7 days or longer

###### Useability

User-friendly and easy to use with a click of a button.

#### Who is Vpatch for?

The VPC system is a mHealth solution for clinicians and physicians to monitor patients remotely and
unobtrusively to aid faster and better diagnosis and treatment.

Cardiovascular disease and stroke are still the number one killers in both modern and developing
nations around the world, and the numbers of patients are increasing as we live longer.  Every year
there are 4.5 million cardiovascular deaths in Europe, over 1 million in the USA, 3.8 million in
India and 1 in 5 Chinese adults have cardiovascular disease.  These numbers are expected to increase
by 40% by the year 2035.


Almost half of heart related calls to the doctor are due to the most common arrhythmia, atrial
fibrillation, (AF).  Often missed by conventional detection methods such as Holter tests, AF can
lead to blood clots and strokes if left untreated.


With a light weight design and long battery life, Vpatch is able to be worn discreetly by a patient
for a week or more, making it far more likely to detect unfelt cardiac events and aiding with swift
diagnosis and immediate treatment.

#### Why use Vpatch?

With better diagnostic yield and significantly longer monitoring periods, Vpatch is the leading
cardiac detection device on the market.

The bourgeoning health trend is in early detection and treatment using mHealth technologies to save
time and money based on prevention for patients and institutions.


As cost effective as it is clever, Vpatch is suitable for hospital, home or remote monitoring and is
self- activating when arrhythmias are detected. There are no leads which reduces motion artefact
error by over 90% and patients can go about their normal business while being monitored. Patients
under investigation are more likely to be diagnosed, not only for an event, but for a pattern of
occurrence to aid with treatment decisions.


Vpatch complies with reimbursement criteria in Australia and other countries using similar
diagnostic related groupings for Government or Private Health Insurance.
